patches.problem: MLB's binding blocker was the absence of a finals source carrying game ids. Schedule, starter and result data arrived via manual odds-page uploads and search relays, which are IDENTIFIED_UNCONFIRMED and can never bind.

MLB StatsAPI schedule?hydrate=probablePitcher and boxscore client emitting gamePk-keyed records; a starter is CONFIRMED only from a boxscore gamesStarted line once the game is underway, never from a probable listing

feed_sweep: one command pulls all four leagues, writes append-only content-hashed snapshots under data/feeds/YYYY-MM-DD/, and surfaces cross-feed disagreements as CONFLICT without silently resolving them
feed-produced result rows carry namespaced canonical ids (ESPN_GAMEID:/MLB_GAMEPK:) plus source and fetched_utc, and bind through result_binding_gate.binding_proof

market capture layer (VALUATION/AUDIT ONLY, its own namespace, no forecast-path import — enforced by the market_capture firewall): SportsGameOdds + The Odds API env-key clients with loud stub mode, owner-specified record schema, consensus as a set of book prices plus computed medians with Circa as its own labelled sharp-reference book, and 2+ point book disagreement surfaced as CONFLICT

historical/movement store (market_history + market_moneyline): owner history schema with typed line_kind (OPENING/CONSENSUS/BEST_AVAILABLE/SHARP_BOOK/CLOSING, never one column) and the temporal firewall — a pregame forecast path can never read a closing line or a post-cutoff snapshot

causal backtest evaluation layer (backtest_causal): PointInTime store fail-closed on post-cutoff reads, entry = last price at/before decision (never backfilled), close = last price in the named 15-minute window (Circa, Pinnacle fallback), consensus close from books observable at the cutoff, CLV post-wager only, walk-forward folds with purge/embargo, shift(1) rolling-feature lint, event-level train/test split, news timestamp trichotomy (publication_time governs)

calibration layer (calibration.py) shipped DORMANT: sample-size gate refuses any fit under 500 events (current WNBA bound Tier-1 base is n=4), Platt->beta->isotonic ladder, calibrator fits only on out-of-sample predictions, log loss primary, decision table encoded verbatim

P0 market data quality (market_quality): canonical event identity across feeds, odds quality fields (quote_age_seconds/stale/missingness/market_status/schema_version) attached as new versions never rewrites, versioned snapshot envelopes (raw+normalized+schema_version+ingestion_run_id), and the dq_gate battery (uniqueness, timestamp ordering, ranges, team mapping, missingness)

patches.problem: The mc_engine lineage's convergence gate (3-sigma batch-block check on simulated probabilities) raised ConvergenceError and killed the slate builder with exit 1 (observed: 2.968pp on HOU@NYM, 2.715pp on COL@ATL); the sportsmodel/main lineage had no convergence gate at all, so a simulator measuring its own RNG could emit an actionable probability.
changes: port the batch-block convergence check from lineage/mc_engine_20260830/harness/mc_engine.py (CONVERGENCE_SIGMAS=3.0 on the pooled-Bernoulli se of a block proportion, TRIALS=30000, BLOCKS=10) as harness/mc_convergence.py
register the named tolerance MC_CONVERGENCE_TOL_PP=2.7386pp, derived not tuned: the worst-case (p_pool=0.5) value of the ported per-game threshold 3*sqrt(0.25/3000)*100

bind the gate INTO the forecastable/actionable gate: a CONVERGENCE_FAIL demotes the game to forecast-only (actionable=False, input_value_policy=REGISTERED_FALLBACK_ONLY, verdict and pre-demotion state recorded for audit); the rest of the board still builds — fail-closed, not fail-loud-process-kill
convergence never promotes: a clean verdict leaves a degraded freshness disposition non-actionable
regression tests: synthetic gap above tolerance demotes with audit recorded and the board builds around it; gap below tolerance keeps the normal actionable path
